title: Child-safety picture check for clips: look at a video's first-frame thumbnail before 'remove her clothes'
description: Follow-up of MPI-1056 (Fabio 2026-10-10). The picture check looks at images only, so 'remove her clothes' on an imported VIDEO passes. Use the first-frame thumbnail every video card already has. Owned by the MPI-1056 sessions: plan in plan.md, pick up from the handoff.
